Same serious phase of the fight shows her reading and slipping past Luffy's attacks; ch. 520 only shows the limit of it against Gear 2.

results.note: Wiki's Observation section reuses the ch. 519 citation, so the scraped 520 hint is one chapter late.

haki.evidence: Denjiro is one of four Scabbards who cut Kaidou's scar with Oden Two Sword Style, requiring advanced Armament/Ryuo.
Never displayed on-page; only sourced to his Vivre Card, so dated to his main combat showing.

results.note: Armament could arguably be 986, when the Scabbards collectively wound Kaidou, but 992 is the first clearly individual display.

haki.evidence: Scopper Gaban senses the abnormal black-lightning Haki accompanying the Holy Knights' arrival on Elbaph (ch. 1139, p. 6).

results.note: The sensed Haki burst is attributed to the Holy Knights' arrival rather than to Gunko alone; her Observation is only implied much later in the ch. 1185 flashback.

haki.evidence: In her Nika form she hardens her inflated fist to strike Luffy from behind and launch Marcus Mars, visibly hurting the rubber man.
King uses Hardening on his blade to clash evenly with Zoro's Haki-coated swords and overpower him (ch. 1032, pp. 14-15).
Never shown on-page; sourced only to his Vivre Card, so dated to the end of his fight with Zoro.

results.note: An earlier Armament read is possible around 1022-1023, where King shrugs off and blocks Zoro's Enma strikes, but the first explicit hardening is 1032.

haki.evidence: During Marineford, Doberman and Ivankov's remarks about Luffy being Dragon's son hint that Dragon has Haki.

results.note: Dragon has no Haki section and no Haki category on the wiki; his abilities are explicitly 'largely unknown'. Chapter 570 is only a hint, never a confirmation - null would also be defensible here.

haki.evidence: Watching Block D, Luffy works out that Rebecca's flawless evasion means she is using Observation Haki.

results.note: She is seen dodging everything from ch. 722-723, but the reader is only told it is Observation Haki at 725.

haki.evidence: Chapter 1059 reveals Shakky as a former Kuja Pirates captain and Empress of Amazon Lily, from which Haki is inferred.

results.note: The wiki only assumes she has Haki from her Kuja/Empress status; she is never shown or stated to use it.
